protocol.candidate_commit: resolved from git before the complete experiment; see results manifest
protocol.harness: crates/tensor4all-treeaci/examples/convergence_g0.rs; identical harness and g0 test fixture on both revisions
protocol.profile: release, locked default CPU platform features (faer on Linux)
protocol.order: case-major; baseline/candidate alternating first arm by case+repetition; no selective reruns
protocol.priming: both arms run R5 nblock T0.1 once, discarded equally; fixed one-second busy loop on measurement CPU before each arm
protocol.metric: construction seconds, excludes fixture construction and sampled output evaluation
protocol.statistic: sum of per-case medians; per-case median ratios; all raw repetitions retained

acceptance.quality: all returned arms satisfy unchanged normalized sampled max <= 5e-4 and relative sampled L2 <= 0.007 on all 1093 original points plus the independently computed global analytic peak (1094 points). The peak normalizes the sampled maximum; sampled error checks are not a full-grid error certificate.

protocol.invalidity: any noise or validity failure makes the whole experiment INCONCLUSIVE; retain every case; a new attempt requires a complete paired rerun
protocol.scope: correctness repair, not a speedup claim or attribution of #896; no comparison with historical dependencies and no RSI execution
protocol.registration: Complete rerun after retaining the original INCONCLUSIVE study; source revision adds the independent analytic reference peak to all 1093 original samples. No samples, cases or numerical thresholds are removed or loosened.

limitations: Three repetitions; descriptive medians without confidence intervals. Quality is checked on 1094 points per arm, not exhaustively. WSL host frequency and scheduling are not fully observable. Does not isolate historical #896 differences.
